name: Brigid
loreTies: Source: Aos Sí/Sídhe (mound gates, hidden courts, fae ancestry)
shortBackstory: Brigid is the emerald-oath battery — the Aos Sí-source whose mound-gate renewal draws power from the hidden courts beneath the hills.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Brigid was born from the mound — the hidden court beneath the hill where ancient power is stored. He is the battery who renews through the pact between surface and deep. Ancient humans saw the sídhe — but they saw the mystery and missed the mechanism.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Tuatha, Brigid is the reason the faction has energy to spend. His mound-gate renewal draws power from hidden courts. He works with Dagda — Dagda grows the terrain, and Brigid draws power from what grows.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Brigid by severing the pact. The Hollow broke the contract between surface and deep — the surface gave, but the deep returned nothing. A pact requires both parties to exist.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Roots Below the Gate, Brigid powers the Tuatha through mound-gate renewal. His emerald-oath staff channels deep-earth energy. But the Hollow breaks the pact — his mound-gates return nothing.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Brigid's flaw is that he has always believed the pact is eternal. He has never questioned the contract because it has never failed. The Hollow teaches him that the oldest pacts are the most vulnerable, because their age makes them invisible.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythological_sources: Morrigan (Cath Maige Tuired, Tain Bo Cuailnge)
human_echo: Morrigan's battle-crows were the real doom-omens humans saw before battles
